prompt_en: A photorealistic location editorial of an adult woman working as a textile conservator carrying a rolled linen banner toward a medieval stone gatehouse in late afternoon during thinning mist. Use the attached portrait as a visible appearance reference for her long dark wavy hair, brown eyes, softly oval face, and natural lip shape. She wears a charcoal wool coat and practical leather boots, her hands supporting the fabric roll at waist height, paused three steps before the entrance while looking up at the ironwork. A heavy iron portcullis is suspended halfway down inside the entrance arch, its intersecting vertical and horizontal bars and pointed lower teeth clearly visible. The grille's two side edges sit in continuous vertical stone grooves, and the open space beneath its teeth reveals the receding vaulted passage. The gatehouse consists of two substantial stone towers flanking this single central passage, joined by a masonry chamber above the arch. Show the tower bases, entrance and upper connecting chamber together so the gatehouse reads as one defensible building. The woman stands beside the opening rather than overlapping the grille. Wet paving catches pale sky reflections, and a small warm lamp deep in the tunnel gives the entrance a readable depth. Frame a vertical environmental portrait from a slightly oblique viewpoint, with the woman in the lower left and the entire central entrance visible. Keep the portcullis bar pattern, stone grooves, flanking towers and the reference-based face legible within one natural photographic exposure. The architectural reading is explicit: a heavy gridded gate occupies the entrance opening; the grid edges sit inside vertical guide grooves; the gate is partly lowered along those upright grooves. Soft reflected skylight picks out the inner groove lips while a slightly elevated camera keeps both stone channels separated from the woman’s silhouette.
